explanation: W = 1.45 GeV is below the η-meson electroproduction threshold (W_min = m_proton + m_η ≈ 1.486 GeV). At this kinematics, the code evaluates sqrt((W² + m_p² - m_η²)² - 4W²m_p²) = sqrt(−0.200), which is imaginary. This produces NaN throughout all radiative correction calculations. The code contains no validity checks and will silently output corrupt results. Please increase W to ≥ 1.487 GeV.
